name: Therm-a-Rest NeoAir XTherm NXT insulated sleeping pad
summary: Manufacturer-documented Regular Wide / Neptune sleeping pad: 7.3 R-value, 540 g and 183 × 64 × 7.6 cm. The owner reports an Amazon warning not to use below −20 °C; manufacturer clarification remains pending.
description: This profile documents the manufacturer’s Regular Wide / Neptune model 14016. R-value describes resistance to heat flow; it is not a guaranteed minimum air temperature. The owner confirms the Canadian product-page identity and reports a prohibition on use below −20 °C. The retailer link retains that restriction and does not establish the safety of a particular sleep system or authenticate the delivered unit.
